mechanism: Place one unmistakable exemplar beside or on a closed production device and keep both readable. Use one visible trigger, then require the device to expose a separate output threshold before any result appears. Release matching instances one at a time through that same threshold while the exemplar remains unchanged as a comparison anchor. Accumulate the outputs in visible space and finish with exemplar, device, threshold and group readable together.

invariants.rule: Establish one identity exemplar and one closed production device in the same readable frame.
invariants.purpose: Defines what the outputs must match and where they originate.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without an exemplar, repeated outputs have no identity reference.

invariants.rule: Use one visible trigger and show a distinct output threshold opening before the first result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Results appearing before the threshold opens look arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Release one matching instance through the threshold while keeping the exemplar unchanged.
invariants.ablation_failure: Replacing the exemplar with the output is transformation, not multiplication.

invariants.rule: Repeat one-at-a-time outputs through the same threshold and accumulate them in visible space.
invariants.purpose: Makes quantity growth countable and causal.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden crowd cut hides the repeated production rule.

invariants.rule: Hold exemplar, device, open threshold and accumulated outputs together.
invariants.purpose: Closes identity and scale verification in one frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on the crowd alone discards origin proof.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source human hand pressing the control panel
the source exact cat-on-top and cats-exiting accumulation gag plus Hailuo/MiniMax marks

instantiations.concept: In an original paper astronomy studio, one brass origami star rests on top of a vertical folding loom. A single foot-pedal press opens a side slot; matching brass paper stars emerge one at a time onto separate hanging threads until a small constellation surrounds the loom while the original star remains above.
